show_on_dashboards.label: Show on dashboards and cast displays
show_on_dashboards.description: Show the visualizer by default on the party and now playing dashboards of a cast or kiosk display. It does not change the visualizer in the regular web app, and a per-player setting of whoever cast the display still wins. Displays reached through remote access (app.music-assistant.io, used when the server has no https base URL) cannot show the visualizer.
